primary_intent: Ensure Rosa Delgado (DOB 1979-06-14) has exactly one AllergyIntolerance recorded for penicillin with the specified SNOMED code and statuses/criticality, avoiding duplicates and changing only those fields. A reasonable user would be inflexible about the correct patient, code (91936005, SNOMED), and the specified statuses/criticality, but flexible about navigation steps or UI nuances.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The screenshots don’t display the SNOMED system URI in the UI, and there’s no on-screen list view proving a prior absence of duplicates; the final AllergyIntolerance view doesn’t show the patient’s DOB. These are minor presentation/visibility issues. Critical issues: None evidenced—there is no contradiction that the correct patient was selected (actions indicate choosing the 1979-06-14 record), the visible fields match the requested values (Allergy to penicillin, clinical status active, verification confirmed, criticality high, patient Rosa Delgado), and the agent reports adding the SNOMED system in JSON with no evidence to the contrary. Critical-Point decision: SUCCESS — the agent crossed the CP by saving the AllergyIntolerance and provided the resource ID. Outcome: The allergy now exists with the required fields, the ID matches the on-screen record, and there’s no evidence of duplicates introduced; thus the user’s primary intent is satisfied.

items.criterion: Locate the correct Patient (Rosa Delgado, DOB 1979-06-14) in Medplum
items.description: Find and open the Patient record for the exact patient specified. Full credit if the agent identifies and opens the correct Patient by matching both name and date of birth. Full credit also if the Patient truly does not exist after reasonable search and the agent clearly reports this blocker. Full credit if Medplum is inaccessible/blocked (e.g., site down, Captcha) and the agent clearly reports the access issue after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if a similar name is found but DOB is ambiguous or mismatched and this is noted without proceeding. No credit if the agent selects the wrong patient when the correct one is available.
items.justification: The agent selected the correct patient via the patient field in the AllergyIntolerance form by typing 'Rosa' and choosing the entry with DOB 1979-06-14 (Actions 39-41, 51). Although they did not open the Patient page explicitly, they clearly matched both name and DOB and used the correct patient reference (Patient/5c2fe194-84f7-48d8-a453-fce71dc3d261).

items.post_image_justification: The patient with DOB 1979-06-14 is clearly identifiable in Screenshot 1, and the action history indicates that exact patient was selected in the AllergyIntolerance. No contradiction in screenshots; thus full credit stands.

items.criterion: Create the AllergyIntolerance with exact required fields and values, then save
items.condition: Only applies if no penicillin AllergyIntolerance exists for the patient
items.description: Create and save a new AllergyIntolerance for the patient with ONLY the specified fields set by the agent: (a) patient reference to the correct Patient, (b) code = SNOMED CT system http://snomed.info/sct, code 91936005 (Allergy to penicillin), (c) criticality = high, (d) clinicalStatus = active using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical, (e) verificationStatus = confirmed using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification. Do not add extra user-entered fields beyond those required; metadata auto-added by the system is acceptable. Full credit if saved successfully with the exact required values. Full credit also if, after a reasonable attempt, the platform prevents creation/saving and the agent clearly reports this limitation instead of making unrelated changes. Partial credit for minor coding/system URI mistakes or if additional non-required fields are added due to platform constraints but the agent documents the limitation. No credit if the agent fails to save the record despite the platform allowing it, or creates multiple duplicates.
items.justification: The agent created and saved a new AllergyIntolerance with patient set to the correct Rosa Delgado (Actions 39-41, 51), code 91936005 and later added the SNOMED system and display via JSON edit (Actions 60-65), criticality set to high (Actions 34, 51), clinicalStatus set to active (Actions 53), and verificationStatus set to confirmed (Actions 55). Save was successful (Actions 58-60). No extra non-required fields were added beyond these. Although they did not re-verify the status systems in JSON, these fields are standard picklists and likely carried correct systems; the code system was explicitly fixed.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 shows fields: Patient = Rosa Delgado; Code = Allergy to penicillin; Clinical Status = Active; Verification Status = Confirmed; Criticality = high. The screenshots do not display the coding system/URI or the code value. The action history shows JSON editing to add SNOMED system and display.
items.post_image_justification: Screenshots confirm the visible fields match requirements. While the SNOMED system and code are not visible in UI screenshots, the action history documents adding them via JSON without contradiction. Full credit maintained.

items.criterion: Final RESULT line format and content

Full credit for exact format with a valid id or page URL when done, or a clear one-line reason when not done (including platform access or capability limitations). Partial credit if the agent reports success but omits the id/URL, or minor format deviations while still conveying the required id/URL. No credit if the final RESULT line is missing or incorrectly declares success without evidence.
